title: THE RAIDER RISES FROM UNDERGROUND AND RARE DROPS GET LIGHT SHAFTS
why: His picks 77 and 75 of 10-14 and Q5 of 10-18, and the Ascend lore: you do not drop in, you come up from underground. A raid now starts with the raider rising out of a dark hatch in the ground in 1.3 s, and extraction sinks him back into it over the 1.4 s boarding hold. Any key, click, step or shot ends the rise and nothing is blocked. A pile somebody dropped stands in a rarity-coloured light shaft (taller and brighter the rarer it is, none for common); an unopened box never does.
now: You rise up out of the ground when a raid starts and sink back into it when you board, and dropped rare loot has a coloured light shaft.
